1: Dawn on a dusty dirt road leading away from a small whitewashed Portuguese hill town with a dark ruined castle on top. A thin Portuguese boy of eight with a pale face, large dark eyes and short dark hair, in a plain undyed wool tunic, barefoot, carrying a small cloth bundle, walks away down the road beside a tall travelling priest in a long dark cloak and wide-brimmed hat, who is seen only from behind. The boy has turned his head to look back over his shoulder toward the town, his face clearly visible in three-quarter view, solemn. Their two long shadows stretch ahead of them down the road. Wide shot from behind and to the side, the town small and high in the background. Nobody else is in the scene.
4: A bleak, wide Castilian plain at evening under a huge sky, stony ground and a few twisted holm oaks; far in the distance on a rise, the dark silhouette of a square castle tower over a small town. In the middle ground a tall travelling priest in a long dark cloak and wide-brimmed hat, seen from behind, walks away alone back along the road; in the foreground a thin barefoot boy of eight in a plain undyed wool tunic stands beside an old shepherd with a long crook and a sheepskin cloak, a flock of sheep around them; the boy watches the priest go, his face in profile, lit from the side by the low sun. Long shadows. Nobody faces the camera.
6: A hillside pasture on the Castilian plain at dusk, wind bending the dry grass, a flock of sheep grazing around him: a lean Iberian young man of about twenty-two with a weathered face, deep-set dark eyes, dark brows, short dark curly hair and a short dark beard, in a rough dark wool shepherd's tunic with a sheepskin over his shoulders, leans on a long wooden shepherd's crook and looks out across the plain. Medium shot from the waist up, three-quarter view, his face clearly visible and lit by one hard low light from the side, calm and thoughtful. Clouds and mist behind him. He is alone with the sheep.
8: Night on a crooked country road under a pale moon: a lean Iberian young man of about twenty-two with short dark curly hair and a short dark beard, a sheepskin over his shoulders and a small bundle slung on his back, walks away from the camera down the road toward the distant glow of many campfires and the pale pointed shapes of army tents on the horizon. In the foreground, a long wooden shepherd's crook is left leaning against a low dry-stone wall. He has turned his head slightly, his face half visible in profile, lit by the moon. Long moonlit shadows, mist low on the fields. Nobody else is on the road.
